entities.name: Tyree
entities.description: An isolated island on Dominaria cursed by a witch's spell, its sea boiling blood-red.

entities.name: Quetzan
entities.description: A woman who mastered legendary powers and led the natives against pirates; killed by Samal and Marik.

entities.name: Samal the Razor
entities.description: Famous pirate captain who tricked his way to Tyree and killed Quetzan.

events.summary: Slavers abuse the peaceful Tyree natives, driving them into the interior.
events.quote: This drove the natives deep into the interior

events.summary: Led by Quetzan the natives rise up and drive out the pirates, forbidding the island to all other ships.
events.quote: Then, the natives exploded out of the interior, led by the Witch of Tyree.

events.summary: Samal and Marik use disguises to reach Tyree, trick the islanders and kill Quetzan.
events.quote: and then killed her, cutting her throat and dumping her corpse into the ocean outside the island

events.summary: Quetzan's death triggers a blood curse trapping the pirates on the island.
events.quote: Quetzan's death triggered a blood curse upon the waters of the island

relations.quote: tricked the islanders into bringing Quetzan to them and then killed her
led by the Witch of Tyree
